name: now-playing-plus
description: Console-style Spotify, YouTube Music, local and Windows media playback with fullscreen visuals for Decky Loader.
author: LoZazaMastro

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-translations.mjs && tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters && rollup -c && node scripts/strip-sourcemap.mjs
scripts.check:python: python -m py_compile main.py ytmusic_service.py runtime_compat.py && python scripts/validate-frozen-runtime.py
scripts.verify: npm run check:i18n && npm run check:types && npm run check:python && npm run check:steam && node --check dist/index.js
